blocks.text: Transparent (shaffaf) medium par woh khaas angle of incidence jis par reflect hone wali light taqreeban plane polarized ho, polarizing angle kehlata hai. Maan lein unpolarized light ki beam medium 2 ki surface par parti hai (Fig. 8.6). Agar reflect hone wali beam taqreeban plane polarized ho, to polarizing angle i = θₚ par reflected aur refracted beams ek doosre se 90° par hoti hain. Is liye:

blocks.title: Interesting Information
blocks.text: Malus ka law biological systems mein light ki polarization parhne ke liye bhi istemal hota hai, jaise cell membranes se light ki polarization.

blocks.text_alt: n₁ sin θₚ = n₂ sin θᵣ
n₁ sin θₚ = n₂ sin(90° − θₚ)
n₁ sin θₚ = n₂ cos θₚ

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne teesri line mein dono taraf n₂ likha hai (n₂ sin θₚ = n₂ cos θₚ). Pichhli line se sin(90° − θₚ) = cos θₚ, is liye sahi line n₁ sin θₚ = n₂ cos θₚ hai; isi se aage tan θₚ = n₂/n₁ nikalta hai.

blocks.text_alt: sin θₚ / cos θₚ = n₂ / n₁

blocks.text: Yeh equation Brewster ka law kehlati hai. Is mein n₁ medium 1 ka aur n₂ medium 2 ka refractive index hai. Agar medium 1 hawa ho to n₁ = 1 aur n₂ = n, to equation tan θₚ = n ban jati hai; yahan n us medium ka refractive index hai jis par light parti hai. Yani Brewster ne sabit kiya ke jab medium 1 hawa ho to polarizing angle ka tangent medium 2 ke refractive index ke barabar hai. Woh angle θₚ jis par reflected aur refracted rays ke darmiyan 90° ho, Brewster angle θ_B bhi kehlata hai; tab tan θ_B = n.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: θₚ + θᵣ = 90° ka matlab: polarizing angle par reflected ray aur refracted ray L-shape (90°) banati hain. Sheeshe (n ≈ 1.5) ke liye θₚ ≈ 57°, pani (n ≈ 1.33) ke liye θₚ ≈ 53°.

blocks.title: Example 8.1
blocks.problem: Light ki ek beam √3 refractive index wali sheeshe ki plate par polarizing angle par parti hai. Light ka angle of refraction kya hoga?
steps: Brewster ka law: tan θ_B = n
Polarizing angle par θ_B + θᵣ = 90°, is liye θᵣ = 90° − θ_B = 90° − 60°

blocks.caption: Brewster angle ke relations
rows: n₁ sin θₚ = n₂ sin θᵣ

blocks.prompt: 1.5 refractive index wali sheeshe ki plate ko hawa mein polarizer ke taur par istemal karna hai; polarizing angle aur angle of refraction nikalein. Pani (n = 1.33) se reflect hone wali light kis angle of incidence par poori polarized hogi (numerical 8.7, 8.8)?
blocks.explanation: θₚ = tan⁻¹ 1.5 = 56.3° aur θᵣ = 90° − 56.3° = 33.7°. Pani ke liye θₚ = tan⁻¹ 1.33 = 53°.

items: Malus (1808): sheeshe se reflect hone wali light polarized hai; sheeshe ke liye taqreeban 57° par plane polarized; mez ki surface ki light partially polarized.
Polarizing (Brewster) angle par reflected aur refracted rays 90° par: θₚ + θᵣ = 90° aur tan θₚ = n₂/n₁ = n (hawa se). Example 8.1: n = √3, θ_B = 60°, θᵣ = 30°.
